knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The brush must suit the finish, and the manufacturer's guidance is the reference. Steel and wire brushes can scratch surfaces.
Brushing from the shallow to the deep end, in overlapping strokes, moves the loosened dirt towards the drain.
Housekeeping and laundry equipment in the textbook is outside pool work and is not used in this lesson.

practicalCriteria: Tools are matched to the finish, and the brush choice is justified by the manufacturer guidance
Walls are brushed from shallow to deep in overlapping strokes towards the drain
Weekly order is followed and the tasks done are recorded
Worn or damaged tools are identified and replaced
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Weekly cleaning record for one pool
Assessor observation sign-off on brushing technique
Tool replacement record where a tool was replaced
stopWorkCriteria: Steel or wire brush used on a liner or a surface the manufacturer forbids
Housekeeping equipment used in the pool
Powered tool used near water without the required protection
